title: TimesFM horizon × domain factorized output-head View
hypothesis: A small horizon-by-domain factorized affine output-head code fit on early ETTh1/ETTm1 windows can improve later-window point-forecast quality over frozen TimesFM and a single shared affine calibrator, while using less serialized state than independent domain×horizon calibrators.
physical_object: One frozen official google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch checkpoint; model state is shared across all domains and forecast horizons.
mirror_coordinate: A separable affine head: yhat[d,h] = (u[d] * v[h]) * yhat_raw + (a[d] + b[h]) for d∈{ETTh1,ETTm1}, h∈{96,192,336,720}. The 12 float32 coordinates are serialized with metadata; no checkpoint or calibration state is free.
logical_multiplicity: Eight dataset-domain × horizon-specific point forecasting functions from one shared pretrained decoder and a factorized calibration code.
prior_art_delta: TimesFM already supports user-selected horizons from a shared patch decoder. This screen tests whether a compact learned output head provides useful horizon/domain specialization beyond native horizon selection and ordinary shared/per-cell affine calibration.

data.split: Per dataset, first 60% chronological rows provide calibration fit windows; next 20% provide validation only; final 20% is fresh audit. All windows are ordered, context uses only rows before its origin, and targets remain within their respective split.
data.window_selection: For each channel and dataset, fit 4 evenly spaced origins in the first 60% with context 512; validation 2 evenly spaced origins wholly within the next 20%; audit 3 fixed evenly spaced origins wholly within the final 20%, with audit horizon targets fixed at H=720 and all shorter horizons scored at the same origins. No audit labels/forecasts will be accessed for fitting or selection.
data.pretraining_overlap: ETT benchmark availability may overlap TimesFM training corpora; this is a later-time evaluation of fixed series, not an independent-pretraining audit.

controls: Frozen zero-shot TimesFM native horizon output
One global affine calibration shared across domains and horizons
Additive domain + horizon affine calibration (native low-parameter control)
Independent per-domain × horizon affine calibration (upper storage/quality reference)
Factorized rank-one domain × horizon affine head (candidate Mirror form)

selection.fit: Fit affine head coefficients by least-squares on first-60% calibration windows; fit shared/additive/factorized models on identical forecast/target pairs. No pretrained weights updated.
selection.validation: Use next-20% only to select from the frozen list of affine forms; choice and code are frozen before loading final-20% audit labels.
selection.primary_metric: Mean per-window MASE, macro-averaged over datasets and channels.
selection.compute_limit: CPU measurements only. The registered H100 latency cannot be established in this CPU-only container; quality/bytes remain measurable. No H100 claim will be made.

gates.promising: On both datasets, factorized View improves audit MASE by at least 1% over frozen TimesFM and at least 0.5% over the additive native calibration; sMAPE does not worsen >0.5%; complete payload is smaller than independent per-cell calibrators; CPU head overhead p95 <=10% of model inference.
gates.fail: View misses the quality gate on either dataset, matches a simpler control within 0.1%, or adds no quality/storage Pareto improvement.
gates.not_established: Official checkpoint or declared fresh windows cannot be executed/verified, or fewer than 5 channels survive data validation. H100-specific latency remains separately NOT ESTABLISHED regardless of quality outcome.

storage.reporting: Report shared checkpoint once, method-specific state bytes, complete payload, and source bytes separately. No parameter-count-only compression claim.
